::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
One of the earliest and largest semiconductor design operations in India. Hyderabad is Qualcomm's largest engineering centre outside San Diego. Qualcomm announced a 2nm tape-out by its Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad teams on 2026-02-07, then began India layoffs reportedly affecting about 1,000 roles from November 2026.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Snapdragon mobile SoCs, 5G modem chipsets, AI/ML inference engines, and automotive connectivity chips. India teams contribute across the full design cycle — architecture, RTL, verification, physical design, and software.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 5/5:** Leading-edge mobile SoCs, 5G modems and RF at 2nm/3nm.
- **Strategic depth 5/5:** India centres form Qualcomm's largest engineering footprint outside the US; contribute across full Snapdragon design cycle.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** Indian teams taped out a 2nm design in Feb 2026, the final pre-manufacturing design stage.
- **India scale 5/5:** About 16,000 employees incl. contract staff (2022); ~20,000 estimated in Nov 2026 reporting.
